informal_statement:
For \(-1\leq z\leq1\),
\[
\sqrt{\lambda^2-z^2}/\lambda=\sqrt{1-z^2/\lambda^2}.
\]
For \(0<t\leq1\), the frozen three-arc and four-arc radical differences equal \(D(2t-1)\) and \(D(t)\), respectively, and their area and perimeter functions equal \(A_3(t),P_3(t),A_4(t),P_4(t)\), respectively.
